summary: New Mountain Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K covering three routine items: a monthly private placement of 2,147 shares at $23.29 per share under Regulation D, a regular $0.19/share distribution, and monthly net asset value disclosure. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing is a normal current report for a continuously offered closed-end fund, disclosing ordinary course sales and operational updates.
